Emphasis should be put on supporting producer organisations (POs) and inter-branch organisations (IBOs) to better coordinate information between operators and processors.The expected services are: 
 1) Data collection, 
 2) Reports, studies and market analysis, 
 3) Dissemination and communication activities, 
 4) IT Services.
